verdict.rationale: The only published sign-in path in the evidence is the EFILE channel, where a filer signs in remotely with an EFILE number and password (cra-docs-16, cra-docs-17). This is a credential-based remote path, but nothing shows it uses MFA, and nothing describes how the main CRA business account sign-in or the Represent a Client access works. missing for 10: evidence of MFA on any sign-in, the sign-in and identity-verification method for My Business Account or Represent a Client, confirmation that no mailed PIN, in-person visit or biometric step is required, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
